projects.title: AeGIS Module Atlas
projects.description: A web-based geospatial intelligence platform built inside a multi-app frontend monorepo, designed to visualize complex spatial data layers across 3 administrative levels, featuring the GEO Mind AI-powered geospatial analysis panel.
details: Co-engineered the 'Atlas' fertilizer demand planning command center, consolidating disconnected agronomic layers (soil nutrients, 6-phase crop cycles) and live inventory data into a unified, high-density dashboard.
Architected multi-app frontend monorepo using Bun workspaces and Turborepo, powering Atlas (geospatial), Halo (auth & admin console), and Tango (planting surveys) with shared UI primitives.
Built Go Fiber v3 modular monolith with domain-per-package architecture, Goose migrations, and PASETO token authorization.
Engineered Martin vector tile proxy with dual HTTP Basic and HMAC token caching to optimize upstream spatial rendering.
Implemented client-side Fertilizer Demand Model (FDM) formula engine with 51 unit tests validating stage-by-stage dosage, land area overrides, and regional demand deltas.
Rebranded AI assistant module to 'GEO Mind' and migrated overview query hooks to dedicated FDM service contract for dynamic stock audits and market penetration logic.
Eliminated national planning blindspots, empowering executives and domain experts to execute live 'Safety Stock vs. Actual Stock' audits across 34 Indonesian provinces.
Integrated AWS End User Messaging Social for transactional WhatsApp OTP authentication and field survey revision alerts.

Prevented browser tab crashes under write-heavy bursts and optimized client-side rendering performance by architecting a state-minimized React 19 vector rendering pipeline for 50k+ multi-polygon agricultural plot boundaries.
Designed the 'Precision Flow' UI framework, optimizing screen data-density for complex geospatial analysis through strict visual contrast hierarchies and monospace telemetry formatting.
projects.rationale: Agricultural decision-support tool for fertilizer distribution planning across Indonesia's 34 provinces.
technicalChallenges: Implemented zoom-aware vector tile styling where map dynamically switches admin level based on zoom with region codes truncated to match province/regency/district and demand data aggregated client-side per visible level.
Built tile proxy with dual auth handling both HTTP Basic and HMAC token auth modes for upstream Martin tile server with token caching and 1-minute expiry buffer.
Managed complex state with useReducer (20+ action types) for filters, regions, map state, demand data, analysis layers, and comparison mode.
Offloaded SNM feature deduplication to Web Worker to avoid blocking main thread during vector tile processing.
Architected a state-minimized React 19 vector rendering pipeline for 50k+ multi-polygon agricultural plot boundaries to prevent browser tab crashes under write-heavy bursts.

projects.title: PINTER AI Agent Platform
projects.description: AI agent orchestration platform enabling enterprise teams to build multi-agent workflows via an interactive visual canvas. Features execution event tracing, MCP tool integration, multi-provider LLM support, and conversation-based chat with agent switching.
details: Architected the migration of a rigid, CLI-based agent prototype into a production-ready enterprise platform using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and custom FastAPI routes.
Designed and implemented the interactive Visual Canvas using React Flow (@xyflow/react) and TanStack Router, representing complex multi-agent topologies and connection graphs.
Engineered multi-agent orchestration supporting 4 native graph patterns: LlmAgent, SequentialAgent, ParallelAgent, and LoopAgent.
Implemented real-time execution event tracing (tool_call, tool_response, agent_transfer, thinking) streamed to clients via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Built hybrid RAG pipeline connecting Qdrant vector database with semantic chunking and enterprise document ingestion.
Integrated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support (stdio and SSE transports) dynamically loaded from PostgreSQL configurations.
Implemented enterprise identity federation (IDENTIK SSO) with encrypted assertions, RBAC permissions, and AES-256 encrypted credential vaults.
Structured domain-partitioned architecture across 8 core domains (identity, agents, conversations, knowledge, integrations, evaluations, governance, content) with 142 automated backend test suites.
Built user token quota management with budget caps, daily/monthly request limits, and automated cost calculation across LLM providers via LiteLLM.
Integrated interactive data visualization blocks in chat including ECharts, Flint Chart, Mermaid diagrams, and KaTeX math formulas.
projects.rationale: Internal enterprise tool for Pupuk Indonesia Holding Company that democratizes AI agent creation for non-technical teams.
technicalChallenges: Executed a 3-phase framework migration from CrewAI to Google ADK without production downtime, using tool wrapping adapters in Phase 2 before full native rewrite in Phase 3.
Implemented async ORM rewrite with buffered execution tracing that flushes events in batches to avoid per-event DB writes that would kill streaming performance.
Designed a custom instruction merging strategy from CrewAI's 3-field (role/goal/backstory) model to ADK's 5-pattern instruction model (identity/mission/methodology/boundaries/examples).

projects.title: NEXUS Module Delta & Vista
projects.description: Enterprise logistics orchestration and automated pathfinding platform. Coordinates and automates Pupuk Indonesia's fertilizer distribution network across Indonesia through inventory tracking (Arca), contract-aware fleet/tariff audits (Delta), and full-screen geospatial pathfinding simulations (Vista).
details: Architected Single-Repo Multi-Entry frontend using Rsbuild and Bun, supporting compile-time profile switches (APP_MODULE=delta) between standalone Delta (port 3001) and unified shell (port 3000).
Engineered modular database architecture with delta_* table prefixes and strict write-isolation boundaries preventing cross-module corruption.
Developed mathematical pathfinding engine using Neo4j and Cypher queries to simulate optimal multi-hop maritime and land shipping corridors.
Built high-performance financial audit tables using @glideapps/glide-data-grid and monospace typography for contract tariffs and vessel fleet capacities.
Implemented immutable shipping tariff audit logs and anomaly alerts for bulk fertilizer logistics across Indonesian distribution hubs.
Designed custom Excel ingestion pipelines (openpyxl / exceljs) syncing historical transport contracts, rate tiers, and fleet capacities into PostgreSQL.
Engineered full-screen geospatial map simulation in Vista module with OpenLayers, calculating contract-aware shipping costs in real-time.
Enforced WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards with oklch-based color palette ('The Cartographic Monolith') across high-density logistics dashboards.
projects.rationale: Internal enterprise logistics coordination and automated route pathfinding platform built for Pupuk Indonesia Holding Company to manage and optimize heavy bulk fertilizer distribution across the Indonesian archipelago.
technicalChallenges: Developed a highly performant mathematical route pathfinding engine to solve complex multi-stop marine logistics and cost-minimization problems.
Designed a comprehensive database schema (using route segments, rate tiers, and contracts) capable of performing water-tight, contract-aware shipping tariff audits.
Adhered to strict 'The Cartographic Monolith' design system using oklch colors with extreme selectively-contrasting highlights and zero drop-shadow elevations.
Optimized high-density data tables containing thousands of tariff records with server-side validation against active carrier contracts.

projects.title: SAM3 Dashboard & Playground
projects.description: An interactive full-stack dashboard for Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3), providing a complete pipeline for image segmentation, model fine-tuning, data labeling, and performance evaluation on geospatial/satellite imagery.
details: Built a complete SAM3 environment with Dashboard (system health), Inference (text/box/point prompts), Training (fine-tuning with TensorBoard), and Evaluation (IoU metrics).
Implemented a 3-phase Data Engine pipeline: Batch Processing → Human Verification (accept/reject/flag) → Polygon Correction with Fabric.js editor.
Developed a Polygon Editor with vertex editing, simplification, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts (V/E/H/D modes), undo/redo, and zoom/pan controls.
Created Dataset management for uploading ZIP datasets (COCO format), converting image+mask folders, and validating local paths.
Exports COCO-format datasets with RLE encoding ready for SAM3 training.
Backend built with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy (SQLite), and OpenCV for image processing.
Frontend built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4, DaisyUI v5, Fabric.js, and Chart.js.
Supports TIFF, PNG, JPG formats with real-time mask visualization overlays.

projects.title: Dapoer Aybun Client
projects.description: Frontend web app for a family-run catering, snack, and drink business. It showcases the business, menu items, customer testimonials, and provides contact information for orders.
details: Showcases catering services, snacks, and drinks (e.g., Kerupuk kangkung, Rendang).
Features a Business profile and service overview.
Includes a Shopping Cart System with validation.
Integrates Direct Checkout via WhatsApp.
Displays Customer testimonials and Contact information.
Built with Vite, Vue 3, Tailwind CSS, and DaisyUI.

projects.title: Land Delineation Training
projects.description: Deep learning model training pipeline for delineating land from satellite imagery. Features preprocessing, BsiNet model implementation, and custom loss functions.
details: Developed a deep learning pipeline for land delineation using BsiNet architecture.
Implemented preprocessing modules using GDAL for satellite imagery (GeoTIFF) handling, including normalization, mask binarization, and resampling.
Created a custom PyTorch dataset loader handling images, masks, contours, and distance maps.
Defined and implemented custom loss functions including Dice Loss, Focal Loss, and a combined LossBsiNet.
Set up a training loop with TensorBoard logging for monitoring model performance.
Built a testing script to generate binary masks from model predictions and save them as GeoTIFFs.

projects.title: Yield Forecasting
projects.description: Predicted crop yield using satellite imagery (Sentinel-2) and ground truth data. Applied classical ML models (RF, XGBoost, LightGBM) and deep learning models (LSTM, GRU) with transfer learning.
details: Predicted crop yield using satellite imagery (Sentinel-2) and ground truth data.
Collected and preprocessed data from East and West Java (2020-2021).
Applied classical ML models (RF, XGBoost, LightGBM) and deep learning models (LSTM, GRU).
Implemented transfer learning for the Lampung region to improve prediction accuracy.
Achieved region-specific yield predictions with improved accuracy.
Gained skills in integrating geospatial data with ML/DL models and remote sensing analysis.

projects.title: Ngeles API
projects.description: A simple API inspired by “No as a Service” that serves categorized and random pantun (poems). Built with Express.js.
details: Developed a simple API inspired by “No as a Service” to serve pantun (poems).
Built endpoints for categorized (/ngeles/:kategori) and random (/ngeles/random) pantun.
Stored data in a local JSON file for lightweight data handling.
Tested functionality to ensure fast and structured access to data.
Gained skills in RESTful API design, endpoint management, and backend development.
